summary: On January 31, 2018, a request was made to rename Hupfield Park located at 85 Hupfield Trail to Viola Desmond Park. Property naming and renaming are a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the Council approved City of Toronto Property Naming Policy and found that this naming proposal meets the policy criteria and process. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division is recommending that Hupfield Park located at 85 Hupfield Trail, be renamed to Viola Desmond Park.
decided: Scarborough Community Council: 1. Adopted the renaming of Hupfield Park, located at 85 Hupfield Trail, to Viola Desmond Park.
